summary.title: Summary

items.title: Towards Explainable Governance of Synthetic Health Data in Collaborative Healthcare Ecosystems
items.subtitle: A. Pelusi, A. Trombetta, D. Spoladore, S. Braghin
bullets: Proposed a role-aware Explainable AI framework for the governance of LLM-generated synthetic health data, translating privacy, fidelity, and reliability metrics into stakeholder-specific explanations aligned with GDPR and the EU AI Act.

items.title: Privacy-Fidelity Trade-offs in Differentially Private Synthetic Tabular Data Generation
items.subtitle: A. Pelusi, S. Braghin, A. Trombetta
bullets: Evaluated Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning of LLMs with differentially private SGD (DP-SGD, via Opacus) for tabular data synthesis, showing feature-level degradation on high-cardinality categorical attributes.

items.title: Categorical Prior Lock-in: Why In-Context Learning Fails for Structured Data
items.subtitle: A. Pelusi, S. Braghin, A. Trombetta
bullets: Compared in-context learning and LoRA fine-tuning for LLM-based tabular data synthesis, characterizing the fidelity of high-cardinality categorical distributions and its trade-off with memorization risk.

items.title: synth-pipeline
items.subtitle: Privacy-Preserving Tabular Data Synthesis Pipeline
bullets: Built an end-to-end, configurable pipeline (PyTorch, PEFT, Opacus) for tabular data synthesis: LoRA fine-tuning of LLMs to generate schema-validated records, with optional Differential Privacy training at a configurable epsilon.

Designed an evaluation framework to measure statistical fidelity (total variation distance, correlation error), downstream utility (train on synthetic, test on real) and privacy risk (distance to closest record, k-anonymity, membership inference attacks).

items.title: chesSLM
items.subtitle: Chess Small Language Model
bullets: Engineered a ~100M-parameter decoder-only Transformer from scratch in PyTorch, with Pre-LN blocks, Rotary Positional Embeddings, causal attention with FlashAttention kernels, and a custom tokenizer.

Trained it on Hugging Face datasets with a two-stage pretraining/fine-tuning curriculum, mixed precision, gradient accumulation, AdamW, and cosine learning-rate scheduling, and deployed it as a Universal Chess Interface (UCI) engine rated ~1650 Elo against Stockfish at limited strength.
